name: fmp_etf_list
description:
ETFs covered by Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), with symbol and name.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/etf-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): limit (integer; sent only when given).
For stocks use fmp_stock_list; for one ETF's holdings fmp_etf_holdings.
Example: {"limit": 50}
